_comment: Manual additions to the known-leads registry (see known_leads.py). 'known' entries are hard blocks - the business is in the pipeline or must never be contacted. 'vetted' entries were checked against a gate on 'checked' and failed; they are skipped only until checked + veto_days, so a company that starts buying ads later becomes eligible again instead of being blocked forever. Gates seen so far: 'live-ads', 'published-email', 'segment'.
